verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official Python SDK for calling its API to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed files. The same SDK is documented for creating, updating, running, and deleting workflows, alongside REST endpoints and an llms.txt that points agents to the SDK. Only one language SDK is evidenced, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond Python (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript), a discoverable OpenAPI spec for generating clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
